title: Chapter 137: Improvement Of Alliance Territory
content:
Chapter 137: Improvement Of Alliance Territory

The Zerg army sent out dogs to run all the passages again, and found that several large passages bypassed the cave base and led to the connecting passage battlefield last night.

There was no threat in the passage, and Wu Qing did not move these passages. He did not know what would happen tonight, so there was no need to move these passages.

The Zerg army withdrew to the Zerg territory, drilled underground to recover energy and injuries, and waited for the next war to come.

Wu Qing arranged all the work in the Zerg territory, and the rest of the things were left to the Zerg Queen to follow up.

The Zerg clone left the Zerg territory with the Zerg guards and went to Daxia Territory. Daxia Territory had some things that Wu Qing needed to deal with personally.

…

In Mengzhong City, the lords of the alliance gathered together, had breakfast, and left Mengzhong City with the refugees and goods purchased from the goblin caravan.

Everyone walked together, and the huge team slowly moved along the avenue, entered the scope of the alliance territory, and then returned to their respective territories.

The Zerg energy coins that the alliance lords brought back to their territories this time, as well as the refugees and goods carefully purchased from the goblin caravans, will bring great development to their territories.

Through the hosts staying in the various territories of the alliance, Wu Qing can see the development and changes of each territory.

Like Meng's Tiger Territory, Meng is rich and powerful. In addition to exchanging a large number of Zerg energy coins with the Zerg, he also made large purchases from the goblin caravans.

This time Meng was very lucky. There happened to be a group of thousands of Tiger refugees in Gong Zhe's caravan. Although the proportion of young and strong among them was less than half, the number was very considerable.

Meng spent a lot of money to buy these rare refugees of his own tribe, and his Tiger Cavalry can finally expand its scale.

In addition to the Tiger Tribe, Meng also selected some races with strong natural combat power to continue to strengthen the war potential of the Tiger Territory.

The Tiger Territory is full of people of relatively strong natural fighting power. The strong ones among them joined the army, and the rest worked for the territory when they were busy, and became members of the territory's reserve militia when they were free, continuing to train and strengthen their strength.

It can be said that the Tiger Territory is a territory born for war. At the critical moment, all the people are capable of fighting.

Now that it has gotten rid of the restrictions of the Tengu clan, it can finally develop and grow to its full potential. This time, Meng purchased thousands of refugees at once, and the population of the territory has increased greatly.

These refugees entered the Tiger Territory and were resettled according to their race. The armies of various races immediately came to assess the refugees and recruited the strong ones among them into the army.

Now the first priority of the alliance's territories is to strengthen the construction of the army.

Meng also purchased a large amount of sophisticated armaments from the goblin caravans and replaced the elite troops of various races. Weapons and equipment are multipliers of the army's combat power.

The difference between soldiers with armor and without armor, light armor and heavy armor is too great, not to mention weapons. The quality directly determines life and death.

After the Tiger Territory's army changed its equipment, the same number of soldiers had a completely different combat power.

Meng was not stingy. He took out a batch of Zerg Energy Coins and gave them to his most trusted elite troops. The Zerg Energy Coins, which contained pure energy, could quickly improve the strength of these elite troops to the strongest state that their luck could support.

This greatly saved the army's training and practice time. As long as people had enough luck, they could quickly improve their strength by absorbing the pure energy in the Zerg Energy Coins.

Meng's large purchase greatly improved the strength of the Tiger Territory. If there was a real war, it would be no problem to pull out tens of thousands of elite soldiers.

Of course, this was due to Meng's long-term business accumulation. This large purchase almost exhausted his accumulated luck and materials.

The situation in other alliance territories was similar. They all gave priority to increasing the population of the main race of the territory, and then purchased some refugees of other races according to needs.

The general territories of the alliance do not have the wealth of the Tiger Territory, so they can only choose some relatively weaker races. They cannot buy various weapons as much as the Tiger Territory, and the number of Zerg energy coins in their hands is not much.

Their territories have developed to a certain extent, but they cannot be compared with the Tiger Territory.

This is related to the original foundation of each territory. Everyone is equal in front of opportunities. Wu Qing gave opportunities, and those territories that did not fully grasp them cannot blame others.

The other four territories in the alliance, except the Tiger Territory, also benefited a lot this time.

Yu Chong's Wutong Village and Bai Yan's Bailangyuan are a little special. They only take in people of their own tribe, and there are no outsiders in the territory.

The number of the Yu tribe is very small. This time Yu Chong only found some wandering Yu tribe members in the caravan, with a number of only dozens of people.

The materials purchased by Yu Chong are also special, mainly materials for making bows and arrows, and few other things.

Therefore, he left the largest number of Zerg energy coins. If all of them are used, it can greatly enhance the strength of the tribe.

The wolf tribe is a large tribe with many subdivisions and a large tribe, so it is also very common.

This time, Bai Yan purchased nearly 3,000 wolf refugees from the caravan, and he spent a lot of money to buy a batch of wolf cavalry weapons and equipment.

It cost a lot, but in this way he can really pull up a wolf cavalry that can be shown off.

Hu Wei and Shi Gan are relatively low-key and conventional. The things they purchase are very miscellaneous and there is nothing special about them.

But if you observe carefully, you will find that Hu Wei, the old fox, spends no less than Meng, but the things he purchases are all carefully calculated, and they look numerous and miscellaneous, and they are not as eye-catching as Meng's heroic purchases.

With these things, the overall strength of Hujiaqiu Territory will not be much weaker than that of Menghu Territory.

The Shi Clan is good at mining and forging, and is very popular in various territories. There is no Shi Clan member in this goblin caravan.

Shi Gan bought some refugees from ethnic groups with a large population in the Black Stone Fort Territory, and also bought a lot of things that other lords could not understand. They themselves are experts in forging weapons and equipment, so they did not purchase weapons and equipment.

This seems insignificant, but Wu Qing knows very well that the forging ability of weapons and equipment in the Black Stone Fort Territory will be greatly improved after completing this purchase.

Perhaps it will not be long before the weapons and equipment of the entire alliance will no longer need to be purchased from outside.

Shi Gan kept silent, but silently fulfilled his promise.

...

In this world, caravans are so important.

Basically, every time a caravan passes by, it is an opportunity for the territories along the way to strengthen their strength. Each territory will achieve the goal of rapid development and growth through transactions with the caravan according to its own financial resources and development needs.

It's just that this time, the alliance territories gained more because of Wu Qing's concession.

After this large-scale purchase and the spoils Wu Qing distributed to each territory last time, the combat capabilities of each territory in the alliance have been greatly improved.
